title: General.
officialText:
This section shall apply only to appliances located in unconfined spaces in buildings of unusually tight construction.
Combustion air supplied by a combined use of indoor and outdoor air shall be supplied through openings and ducts extending to the
appliance room or to the vicinity of the appliance.
